payload.title: Editorial check fails after save on Machines on Machines: Editorial context tenant mismatch
payload.description: After stories save-version on newsroom.machines-on-machines.anth.us in the signed-in lane, on 2026-11-04, the automatic check printed: not checked, GraphQL request failed: Editorial context tenant mismatch. The copy_edit step depends on this check, so Stories on this site may be unable to complete that step. Not yet tested with editorial check-version directly.
